full.title: Full
full.first:
I'm a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer with over a decade of experience, originally from Colombia and now based in Sweden. At EQT Group I build production AI systems: agents, RAG pipelines and MCP integrations for the investment teams. Before that I shipped products at [Klarna](https://www.klarna.com) and [Auth0](https://www.auth0.com), serving millions of users worldwide.

I'm a former [Google Developer Expert](https://glrz.me/gde) in Web Technologies and former [Twitch Partner](https://glrz.me/stream), an international conference speaker at DevFest and Nerdearla, and an instructor at [Platzi](https://platzi.com/profes/glrodasz/) and [Código Facilito](https://codigofacilito.com/).
full.third:
